title: AION 2 Presets: Download and Apply Styles
description: Find AION 2 character presets in the official Style Shop, download and apply shared appearances, and fix account or synchronization problems.
summary: Use Style Shop for shared appearances or recreate a creator's published sliders manually. Match the website account and character, preview first, and check the game's current application cost.
quickAnswer: Select your recipient character on the official Style Shop and download an appearance. In game, open Customizations → Manage Appearance → Refresh, preview the style and check the Quna or voucher cost before applying.

topic.alt: Official English Style Shop with region, period and popularity-sort controls above player appearance previews
topic.caption: Official Style Shop with region, period and popularity filters.

workflow.title: Send a style to the intended existing character
workflow.caption: Send the download to the intended character, then preview and apply it in game.

steps.label: Match identity and recipient
steps.description: Sign in with your playing platform and select the intended character in Change Character.

steps.label: Choose a listing for your region
steps.description: Set your region, inspect the author's preview and open the desired appearance.

steps.label: Download to an offered slot
steps.description: Choose a download slot offered to your account.

steps.label: Refresh on the same character
steps.description: Open Customizations → Manage Appearance in game and refresh before choosing the preview.

steps.label: Review before applying
steps.description: Check the actual appearance and current Quna or voucher terms before confirmation.
